blocks.text: Willingdon Heights Houses: streets and boundaries

items.t: Brentwood Town Centre, one of Burnaby's four City-designated town centres, sits immediately southeast across Lougheed Highway, so the pocket's south edge is a town-centre edge rather than a town-centre address.

Gilmore Avenue is the interior school street: Kitchener Elementary stands at 1351 South Gilmore Avenue and Gilmore Community School at 50 South Gilmore Avenue, both inside the Boundary Road to Willingdon Avenue frame.

blocks.text: Willingdon Heights Houses: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: The pocket's two Gilmore Avenue schools sit on the same street a few blocks apart, so school drop-off traffic concentrates on South Gilmore Avenue rather than on Hastings Street.
Willingdon Avenue is the dividing line: the pocket ends at it, and the Capitol Hill area begins one block east of Willingdon Avenue at the Hastings Street corner.

Hastings Street is the commercial edge, not a residential through street for the interior: the interior house streets run between Hastings Street and Lougheed Highway without a town-centre address of their own.
Hastings Street is the north-edge corridor and Lougheed Highway the south edge, with Brentwood Town Centre across Lougheed Highway to the southeast for the nearest town-centre shopping and services.
Willingdon Avenue runs the pocket's east edge and Boundary Road the west edge, giving two north-south arterials out of the interior streets.

Willingdon Heights home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

18 houses sold in Willingdon Heights with a median price of $1,704,000 (the middle half sold between $1,604,375 and $2,121,500), taking a median of 20 days to sell at 97.6% of the last list price; 33% sold above list. They had a median $694 per square foot, a median year built of 1980 and a median lot of 4,059 square feet.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Willingdon Heights?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 17 houses listed in Willingdon Heights. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Willingdon Heights a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses in Willingdon Heights had a sales ratio of 6%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Willingdon Heights from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 8 houses sold in Willingdon Heights over those 5 months, out of 251 in all of Burnaby.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Willingdon Heights?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: Is this pocket inside Brentwood Town Centre?
faq.a: No. Brentwood is a City-designated town centre immediately southeast across Lougheed Highway, while Willingdon Heights itself is the house and low-rise pocket north of the highway; the town-centre towers begin south of Lougheed Highway.

faq.q: Which elementary school serves the Gilmore Avenue streets?
faq.a: Kitchener Elementary, at 1351 South Gilmore Avenue, is the School District No.

faq.q: What did houses in Willingdon Heights sell for?
faq.a: 18 houses sold in Willingdon Heights between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,704,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Willingdon Heights?
faq.a: The median was 20 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.6% of the last list price (33% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
